name: Cablestrike
description: Whirls the weight once overhead and drops it straight down onto the opponent's head or shoulder.

name: Stiff Slingshot
description: Chokes up on the rope and jabs the weight forward in a short straight punch at the chest.

name: Pondererbump
description: Spins the weight in a flat wheel at waist height and strikes the ribs of the nearest foe as it passes.

name: Holding Weighttip
description: Meets an incoming blow with the taut rope and turns it aside from the body.

name: Whorlhop
description: Steps back while hauling the weight home along the rope to reset the distance.

name: Dropweight Pause
description: Keeps the weight circling past the shoulder and ear in a tight loop that screens the head.

name: Sudden Orbitband
description: Swings the hanging weight back and forth from one hand then lifts it sharply into the opponent's chin.

name: Fixing Cordsplice
description: Flicks the loose end of the rope across the opponent's knuckles to spoil the grip on a weapon.

name: Cablepause
description: Hauls the weight back with both hands and uses the rope to knock a straight thrust off its line.

name: Light Meteorhead
description: Slides one foot aside as the weight swings out so the body leaves the line while the iron keeps threatening.

name: Low Longrope
description: Drags the weight along the ground in a low arc and lifts it into the shins and knees.

name: Gyrehit
description: Throws the weight up and over the shoulder in an overhand arc and cracks it down on the collarbone.

name: Plummet Lid
description: Wraps the rope twice around an opponent's staff or forearm and tugs it off line.

name: Gyreblow
description: Spins the weight on a short rope about the wrist then lets it fly straight at the face.

name: Plumbwedge
description: Braces the taut rope against the forearm and elbow so it absorbs a downward cut without parting.

name: Cabletrot
description: Retreats two paces while whirling the weight in a loose ring that holds a pursuer at length.

name: Pushing Revolve
description: Throws a low loop of rope around the ankle and pulls the foot out from under the opponent.

name: Hard Gyre
description: Rolls the weight over the shoulder like a turning wheel and drops it onto the foe from above.

name: Plumblid
description: Keeps the weight circling in a steady ring before the body so that every strike meets swinging iron.

name: Firm Loopend
description: Breaks the circling weight out of its ring and drives it into the opponent's shoulder.

name: Hitching Tailstone
description: Draws the circling weight inward across the opponent's wrist and rattles the grip loose.

name: Nabbing Slingshot
description: Hooks the rope behind the opponent's arm on the backhand pass and pins the elbow.

name: Weightneck Amble
description: Changes the ring from one side of the body to the other while stepping through to a new angle.

name: Gyre Bump
description: Taps the weight against the target at the end of the ring to test the guard with a short sharp knock.

name: Reelback Hop
description: Advances in a heel and toe walk while the weight turns beside the hip and keeps the cord clear of the feet.

name: Backward Reelback
description: Retreats in the same heel and toe walk and trails the weight low so the cord never snags.

name: Flat Plummet
description: Lunges off the back foot and sends the weight straight out to the end of the rope.

name: Hard Weightneck
description: Turns the hips hard and slings the weight round in a flat blow at the ribs.

name: Plumbstay
description: Lifts the taut cord over the shoulder to catch a descending blow and drag it wide.

name: Cordsplice Cowl
description: Pivots on the ball of the foot and lets the ring of cord swat an opponent's lead hand.

name: Fouling Loopend
description: Plants the lead foot and pulls the wrapped cord taut so the opponent is dragged off balance.

name: Gentle Longrope
description: Taps the weight out at several lengths and reads the foe's distance from the tension in the rope.

name: Straight Dropweight
description: Whirls the weight overhead with a thread of qi in the cord and brings it down on the guard.

name: Quick Ropehead
description: Wheels the weight at the flank with the cord held taut by one steady breath of qi.

name: Planted Weighttip
description: Catches a blade on the qi-stiffened cord and turns it past the body.

name: Pondererlid
description: Casts a loop over the weapon arm and cinches it with a sharp pull.

name: Orbitband Dodge
description: Backs away three steps while the weight orbits and the cord never goes slack.

name: Holding Meteorhead
description: Hauls the weight home in one pull and screens the chest as it arrives.

name: Slingshot Hit
description: Leads the hanging weight upward on a pulse of qi and lifts it hard under the opponent's jaw.

name: Cablehit
description: Sends the weight straight down onto a raised guard with qi packed behind the iron.

name: Settled Loopend
description: Rolls the cord along the incoming blade and carries it harmlessly past the shoulder.

name: Gyrelid
description: Wraps the cord about the shoulder joint and tugs to pull the upper body forward.

name: Tailstone Pause
description: Lets the weight drift left and then snaps it right so the opponent's guard follows the wrong side.

name: Easing Meteorhead
description: Skips a step to each side in turn while the whirling weight covers the exit.

name: Whorlpause
description: Anchors the free hand on the cord and braces it across the body against a heavy cut.

name: Resting Weighttip
description: Catches the weight in the palm as it falls from an orbit and kills its motion without a sound.

name: Gyre Drop
description: Lets a glancing blow rebound off the target and uses the bounce to drive the weight back around.

name: Gyrepause
description: Passes the weight from hand to hand in a short loop so the opponent cannot tell which side will strike.

name: Skipping Ropehead
description: Slips the rope free of a grasp by rolling the loop off the wrist and stepping clear.

name: Stopping Reelback
description: Snaps the loose cord against a raised weapon so the rebound spoils the next thrust.

name: Plumbhusk
description: Casts an open loop of cord over the head or arm and draws it shut with a yank.

name: Tripping Tailstone
description: Winds a figure-eight of rope about both wrists while stepping in to take control of the arms.

name: Blunt Spinout
description: Swings the loop and weight in a short arc and raps the side of the head.

name: Hooding Longrope
description: Spins a loop of cord overhead in a flat ring that catches falling blades.

name: Whorllid
description: Draws a slip knot tight around a hilt and wrenches the weapon loose.

name: Plumbamble
description: Whirls a loop across the ground and sidesteps so a chasing foot is caught in it.

name: Pulling Ropehead
description: Drags a loop-bound limb across the floor and tows the foe off balance.

name: Low Revolve
description: Whips the hanging loop upward so the weight clips the underside of the chin.

name: Resting Cordsplice
description: Spins the cord fast enough before the body to form a curtain against thrown darts.

name: Folded Dropweight
description: Hangs the rope across the brow and lets a descending cut slide down its slack.

name: Longrope Stay
description: Sweeps the cord low to meet a leg strike and catch it before it lands.

name: Weightneck Stay
description: Turns the weight in a slow guard circle over the exposed ribs.

name: Hard Meteorhead
description: Turns the guard circle into an outward swat that smacks the attacker's hand.

name: Pondererdodge
description: Breaks out of a clinch with a backstep and a snapping cord that leaves no closing line.
